caption: Jesus suffering and defeating evil fits a wider Christian pattern. But Satan, the Redeemer and the bruised heel are not in Psalm 22:20–21.

slides.alt_text: Editorial slide: Did Psalm 22 predict Satan bruising Jesus? Psalm 22 asks for rescue from a sword and wild animals. Hebrews says Jesus defeated the devil through death.
slides.body: Psalm 22 asks for rescue from a sword and wild animals. Hebrews says Jesus defeated the devil through death.
slides.heading: Did Psalm 22 predict Satan bruising Jesus?

slides.alt_text: The BSB text of Ps 22:20-21: Deliver my soul from the sword … Save me from the mouth of the lion.
